items.markdown:
Polynucleotides are `long chains of nucleotide monomers covalently bonded together` —most notably forming biological molecules like DNA and RNA. In aesthetic medicine and dermatology, they are ultra-purified DNA fractions (usually derived from salmon or trout gonads) used as regenerative injectable biostimulators.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11311621/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polynucleotide)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D2lkNA20FZ8&t=89)[[4]](https://thetweakmentsguide.com/tweakments/polynucleotides/)[[5]](https://aestheticsofessex.co.uk/treatments/polynucleotides-treatment/)

### What They Do

- **Cellular Regeneration:** Once injected into the superficial to mid-dermis, they break down into building blocks that activate fibroblasts (collagen-producing cells).[[1]](https://www.meliorclinics.co.uk/blog/2025/08/04/the-ultimate-guide-to-polynucleotides/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/KTrfrM4p2-8)
- **Collagen & Elastin:** They stimulate the natural production of collagen, elastin, and hyaluronic acid from within.[[1]](https://thetweakmentsguide.com/tweakments/polynucleotides/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/KTrfrM4p2-8)[[3]](https://www.meliorclinics.co.uk/blog/2025/08/04/the-ultimate-guide-to-polynucleotides/)
- **Anti-Inflammatory:** They reduce tissue inflammation, neutralize free radicals, and promote blood vessel growth (angiogenesis).[[1]](https://drmedispa.com/treatments/polynucleotide-treatments/)[[2]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11311621/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D2lkNA20FZ8&t=89)
- **Not a Filler:** Unlike traditional dermal fillers, they do not physically add artificial volume or alter facial architecture; instead, they repair and rejuvenate the skin's quality.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/HealthcareGroupGuernsey/videos/what-are-polynucleotides-and-how-can-they-improve-your-skin-watch-as-dr-harriet-/661946210274612/)[[2]](https://www.meliorclinics.co.uk/blog/2025/08/04/the-ultimate-guide-to-polynucleotides/)

### Common Uses & Applications

- **Under-Eye Rejuvenation:** Smoothing fine lines, reducing dark circles, and improving thin skin without the risk of puffiness.
- **Skin Quality:** Improving crepey skin, elasticity, hydration, and overall tone on the face, neck, hands, and décolletage.
- **Scar & Acne Treatment:** Softening the appearance of acne scars and supporting general wound-healing.
- Learn more about clinical protocols and expected timelines via specialized providers like [Harley Street Dermal](https://harleystreetdermal.co.uk/polynucleotides/) or [Melior Clinics](https://www.meliorclinics.co.uk/blog/2025/08/04/the-ultimate-guide-to-polynucleotides/).[[1]](https://thetweakmentsguide.com/tweakments/polynucleotides/)[[2]](https://www.meliorclinics.co.uk/blog/2025/08/04/the-ultimate-guide-to-polynucleotides/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hzO4U_AOnfI&t=14)[[4]](https://harleystreetdermal.co.uk/polynucleotides/)

### Treatment Course

- **Initial Series:** Usually a course of 3 to 4 treatments spaced 2 to 4 weeks apart.
- **Results Timeline:** Visible improvements typically emerge 2 to 4 weeks after the final session as cellular turnover progresses.
- **Maintenance:** Top-up sessions are recommended every 3 to 6 months to maintain the regenerative effects.[[1]](https://harleystreetdermal.co.uk/polynucleotides/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hzO4U_AOnfI&t=14)
